title: Kagamine Len — Sparkling Curiosity☆〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: An Ode for the Pure of Heart

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, is that...?
Hey, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I think it's them♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hi, guys!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, it's Len and Rin!
Wonderhoy♪

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Wonderhoy♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You two seem to be in high spirits today!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Of course! Anyways, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: More practice?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. We already practiced a little at the Wonder Stage, but wanted to do a little more.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I also wanted to bring my little friend along too...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your friend?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP! CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh! The Lion Dance Robot!
He's all better now?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, who?
You know this robot, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
You weren't here to meet him last time!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
He's a robot that Rui made!
They came over for New Year's but...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We ran into some trouble and he ended up malfunctioning. Fortunately, he's all better now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You helped me fix him that time too, Len, so I was hoping to show you once he got better.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, okay! Thanks, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Does that mean he won't go chomping away at Tsukasa anymore?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Chomp away? That sounds fun☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think that's a request, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait, wait, wait!
That only happened because it malfunctioned! Things weren't supposed to turn out that way, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! But I'm glad he's all better now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So let's get you introduced to him, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe☆ Nice to meet you, Lion Dance Robot! I'm Rin, and I hope we get to have lots of fun together♪

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP! CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Rui!
We should show them that splishy-splashy thing that we got to see earlier!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Splishy-splashy?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Excellent idea, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, Lion Dance Robot... Go!

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: Burst...!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! Water's gushing from his mouth!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Sometimes we use him as a power washer, but we can also use him to create rainbows for our stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's now “Lion Dance Robot Mk II”...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! This is awesome!
Go! Go! Go!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Go! Go! Go!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They seem to be having fun...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Well, there's been no harm done so far. Let him do what he wants.
KAITO's Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Emu & Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Great work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*... Practice was so much fun☆
Was it fun for you too, Lion Dance Robot?

rows.Speaker: Lion Dance Robot
rows.Line: CHOMP CHOMP CHOMP!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nice. I think he's saying he had a good time!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You two already seem to know him so well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But this is so amazing, Rui. I never knew that you could make robots like this!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, I thought the same thing!
How do you do all this?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, I generally use robots that I can buy commercially as a base...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then I'll try to come up with what it'll look like and what I want it to be able to do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: After that, it's a matter of gathering all the parts I need and building it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Nothing generally works all that well at first, and then I begin thinking about what to add or how to improve it. I usually arrive on a final design through trial and error.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's so cool!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. If you're that interested, would you like to try building one yourself?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me? Really?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course. I'm actually about to start building another one. Why don't you tag along while I go shopping for parts next time?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You should be able to in your holographic form, no?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! I'm definitely going...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then how does this Sunday sound? We don't have practice either, so we can leisurely spend our time looking around.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's great, Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case...!
Emu, Nene, what are you doing this weekend?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm going shopping with my big sis!
It's a little far, but we're going to the really big mall together♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm going to the theatre with my family.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Those both sound like so much fun!
But I don't think I can go if you're with your families...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry, Rin.
We should all go somewhere together next time when we get a chance♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. Good for you, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What about you, Tsukasa?
Are you doing anything this Sunday?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Me? I'll be working as an extra that day!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: An extra?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. I've been meaning to try it out to learn what I can for our performances.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But my charisma may just end up drowning out the main characters entirely! Hah hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Drowning them out with your charisma...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Such is our Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Anyways, Len, I'll see you this Sunday.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I can't wait!
